GOVERNMENT OF UTTAR PRADESH
OFFICE OF THE ASSISTANT COMMISSIONER OF STATE TAX
COMMERCIAL TAXES WARD-3, LUCKNOW

Notice under Section 27 read with Section 129 of the UP GST Act, 2017
Reference No: SCN/UP/2023-24/1111
Date: 19-09-2023

To,
M/s Heritage Handicrafts Expo
GSTIN: 09SSSTT1234S1Z0
Financial Year: 2023-24

1. WHEREAS, enforcement inspection of temporary exhibition stalls at Awadh Shilpgram, Lucknow was conducted by State Tax Officers on 15-09-2023.

2. AND WHEREAS, inspection revealed that M/s Heritage Handicrafts Expo was making taxable retail sales of handicraft items at the venue without possessing valid registration in the State of Uttar Pradesh.

3. IT IS OBSERVED that the entity qualifies as a Casual Taxable Person (CTP) under Section 2(20) of the CGST Act 2017 and was required to obtain temporary CTP registration and deposit estimated advance tax under Section 27 prior to commencing business.

4. ACCORDINGLY, failure to obtain CTP registration and failure to deposit advance tax violates Section 27 read with Section 25 of the Act.

5. NOW THEREFORE, you are called upon to show cause why:
(a) Estimated tax liability of Rs. 1,20,000/- should not be assessed under Section 63;
(b) Penalty of Rs. 50,000/- should not be imposed under Section 129 for operating without registration.

6. You are required to submit your explanation within 7 days from service of this notice.
